title: Timothy Franklyn joins Dentons Link Legal as Partner in Capital Markets practice
description: Timothy Franklyn has joined Dentons Link Legal as a Partner in Capital Markets practice in Bengaluru.Franklyn has over two decades of expertise in advising on complex domestic and international capital markets and corporate finance deals. His extensive experience includes IPOs, QIPs, rights issues, high-yield bonds, convertible bonds, medium-term note programs, and Rule 144A/Regulation S offerings.Fraklyn has spent more than 10 years with leading international law firms, including A&O Shearm
